subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should OpenClaw show directly to end users in channel replies versus keep in logs/status metadata?
rationale: Current code already has model, budget, estimated-token, overage, and session facts, but exposing raw session keys/channel identifiers and exact counts is a user-facing privacy/support policy choice.

options.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
options.body: Show provider/model, effective context budget, measured or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted conversation label through one shared formatter.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Leave chat error copy generic and document status/log commands for operators who need detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Defer to broader visibility design
options.body: Keep this issue open until a broader context-visibility design decides shared UI, logs, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show provider/model, effective context budget, measured or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted conversation label through one shared formatter.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest visible product-routing signal from the issue discussion and current context-usage UI work, while formatter owners can implement once the visible-policy choice is made.
